item.title: Den'ai Kanojo ~Sashuu o Sugite mo Kimi to Itai~
item.description:
ゲーム情報

  • ブランド: Studio Ubai Rouge​
  • 発売日: 2022-10-28
  • スコア: 6.29/10 (7 人評価)
  • 日本語名: 電愛カノジョ ～サ終を過ぎてもきみといたい～
  • 英語名: Den’ai Kanojo Sashuu o Sugite mo Kimi to Itai

あらすじ

A university student named Aizawa Souta spends his days escaping his boring reality by playing a VR game with a beautiful character named Luce. One day, she appears to him outside of the game and pleads with him to have sex with her because the game is on the verge of being shut down due to lack of users. Luce has convinced herself that if the game emphasizes sexuality, it will attract more players. Luce turns to Souta, who she thinks is knowledgeable and experienced in this area, but in reality, he is not, and has never had any experience with women besides what he has learned from games and manga. Despite his lack of real-life experience, Souta agrees to help, but things take an unexpected turn.

item.title: Bub Me Baby! ~Ogyari Saimin Therapy de Aka-chan ni Naare~
item.description:
ゲーム情報

  • ブランド: Studio Ubai Rouge​
  • 発売日: 2019-02-15
  • スコア: 5.71/10 (22 人評価)
  • 日本語名: バブみぃ・べいびぃ！～オギャり催眠セラピーで赤ちゃんになぁれ～
  • 英語名: Bub Me Baby! Ogyari Saimin Therapy de Aka-chan ni Naare

あらすじ

The protagonist, Osanai Haruki, is a overworked corporate employee who is recommended by his psychiatrist, Minato Sakura, to undergo a “regression therapy”. He ends up revealing his repressed desire to regress into infancy and becomes dependent on Sakura and her younger sister, Yuki, who both have overpowering maternal instincts. The story deals with the consequences of Haruki’s regression and how the characters interact and grow closer as a result.
